name: rtunnel-manager
description: rtunnel 管理器 —— 桌面端 SSH 隧道管理面板
author: SII-ljh

scripts.dist: npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --universal && npm run sign:app -- dist/mac-universal/rtunnel.app
scripts.dist:dir: npm run icon && electron-builder --mac dir --universal && npm run sign:app -- dist/mac-universal/rtunnel.app
scripts.dist:mac:intel: npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --x64 && npm run sign:app -- dist/mac/rtunnel.app
scripts.dist:mac:arm: npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && npm run sign:app -- dist/mac-arm64/rtunnel.app
